description: Category-aware attribute decision profiles for Step 3 Section F. These profiles convert category spec expectations and Stackline-backed competitor evidence into PM-readable attribute decisions.

profiles.label: Linears / Shop / Utility Strip Attribute Decisions

baseline_attributes.label: Integrated LED
baseline_attributes.recommendation: Treat integrated LED as the baseline for this luminaire category unless the concept is intentionally LED-ready or socket-based.
baseline_attributes.notes: This should not be treated as a product differentiator for wraparounds, linears, shop lights, or strip fixtures.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which CCT approach should this SKU use?

values.label: Fixed CCT
values.recommendation: Use fixed CCT only when the strongest direct-demand examples are fixed color and price simplicity matters more than configuration flexibility.

values.label: 3CCT selectable
values.recommendation: Use 3CCT when direct competitors show meaningful movement and the goal is commercial parity without adding 5CCT complexity.

values.label: 5CCT selectable
values.recommendation: Use 5CCT only if competitor demand supports a premium adjustable-positioning story.

values.label: Selectable CCT
values.recommendation: Keep selectable CCT in scope when the competitor set shows it as a mainstream buying filter.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which lens or diffuser should be specified?

values.label: Frosted lens
values.recommendation: Use frosted lens when the concept needs broad utility-room diffusion with a cleaner residential/commercial appearance.

values.label: Prismatic lens
values.recommendation: Use prismatic lens when the strongest comparable products lean contractor/commercial and light control matters more than a smooth appearance.

values.label: Clear lens
values.recommendation: Use clear lens only if the market evidence supports output-first positioning and glare risk is acceptable.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which controls should be included or left out?

values.label: Dimmable
values.recommendation: Keep dimmability when it appears on direct competitors or when Sunco wants a mainstream commercial fixture story.

values.label: 0-10V dimming
values.recommendation: Use 0-10V only when commercial controls are part of the SKU thesis or stronger competitors make it expected.

values.label: Sensor-ready / motion sensor
values.recommendation: Treat sensor-ready or motion sensing as a variant-level decision, not a default, unless competitor evidence shows it as a buying filter.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which install features should be scoped for RFQ?

values.label: Surface / flush mount
values.recommendation: Keep surface or flush mounting explicit because it is a core compatibility filter for wraparound and utility fixtures.

values.label: Linkable / daisy-chain
values.recommendation: Include linkability when competitor demand supports garage/shop/utility multi-fixture runs.

values.label: Suspension kit
values.recommendation: Keep suspension hardware as an optional accessory unless direct competitors make suspended installation standard.

values.label: Selectable wattage
values.recommendation: Use selectable wattage when the market evidence supports one SKU covering several replacement/output needs.

values.label: High output
values.recommendation: Use high output when the target lumen tier wins against the comparable set without creating margin or wattage pressure.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which channel/compliance claims should be requested?

values.label: ETL
values.recommendation: Request ETL/UL listing support before RFQ release for hardwired commercial fixtures.

values.label: UL
values.recommendation: Request ETL/UL listing support before RFQ release for hardwired commercial fixtures.

values.label: DLC
values.recommendation: Request DLC only if the intended channel or commercial buyer expects rebate/spec-grade positioning.

values.label: Damp rated
values.recommendation: Keep damp rating when the fixture is positioned for garage, utility, laundry, or light commercial interiors.

baseline_attributes.label: Ceiling fan, not bathroom exhaust fan
baseline_attributes.recommendation: Treat this as a ceiling-fan assortment decision. Do not use bathroom exhaust fan attributes unless Step 1 explicitly names ventilation, CFM exhaust, or sones.
baseline_attributes.notes: This prevents fan categories from inheriting lighting-only integrated LED fixture assumptions.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which fan size and format should this SKU use?

values.label: Low-profile / flush mount
values.recommendation: Use low-profile format when competitor demand points to bedrooms or low-ceiling residential rooms.

values.label: Downrod mount
values.recommendation: Use downrod or dual-mount format when the target room size and competitor set lean toward standard residential ceiling-fan installs.

values.label: 52 in blade span
values.recommendation: Use 52 in as a mainstream residential benchmark when competitor coverage supports a broad-room fan position.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which motor and control package should be in scope?

values.label: DC motor
values.recommendation: Use DC motor when competitor movement supports quieter, more efficient, premium positioning.

values.label: Remote control
values.recommendation: Include remote control when the competitor set treats it as a mainstream buying filter.

values.label: Smart control
values.recommendation: Treat smart control as a variant-level premium feature unless direct evidence shows broad demand.

values.label: Reversible motor
values.recommendation: Include reversible motor when comparable top products use seasonal airflow control as a standard feature.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Should the fan include a light kit?

values.label: No light kit
values.recommendation: Keep the SKU fan-only when competitor demand is strongest for airflow-first products or when Sunco wants to avoid lighting-spec complexity.

values.label: Integrated light kit
values.recommendation: Include a light kit when the winning competitor set uses lighting as a core customer filter; only then should CCT and lumen choices drive the spec.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which rating and compliance claims should be requested?

values.label: ETL
values.recommendation: Request ETL/UL support for the fan motor/electrical assembly before RFQ release.

values.label: UL
values.recommendation: Request ETL/UL support for the fan motor/electrical assembly before RFQ release.

values.label: FCC
values.recommendation: Request FCC support when the SKU includes remote, RF, Wi-Fi, or app controls.

values.label: Damp rated
values.recommendation: Use damp rating when the opportunity targets covered patios, bathrooms, or humid interior locations.

baseline_attributes.label: Bathroom exhaust fan, not ceiling fan
baseline_attributes.recommendation: Treat this as an exhaust/ventilation decision. Do not use residential ceiling-fan blade span or light-kit assumptions unless Step 1 explicitly names them.
baseline_attributes.notes: Bathroom fans should evaluate CFM, sound, controls, and bathroom code/channel fit before decorative ceiling-fan attributes.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which airflow and noise targets should this SKU use?

values.label: CFM airflow
values.recommendation: Use CFM as the primary performance target and compare against room-size norms in the competitor set.

values.label: Low sone rating
values.recommendation: Use low-noise positioning when competitor demand supports a premium quiet bathroom-fan story.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which bathroom control behavior should be scoped?

values.label: Humidity sensor
values.recommendation: Include humidity sensing when direct competitors treat automatic moisture control as a buying filter.

values.label: Motion sensor
values.recommendation: Use motion sensing only when the market evidence supports control convenience over cost simplicity.

values.label: Timer control
values.recommendation: Keep timer behavior in scope when competitor examples emphasize automated shutoff.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which fan listing and channel claims should be requested?

values.label: UL
values.recommendation: Request UL/ETL bathroom exhaust fan listing support before RFQ release.

values.label: ETL
values.recommendation: Request UL/ETL bathroom exhaust fan listing support before RFQ release.

values.label: Energy Star
values.recommendation: Request Energy Star only if the target channel or competitor set supports rebate/efficiency positioning.

attribute_groups.decision_question: Which repeated feature is important enough to keep in scope?

values.label: Dimmable
values.recommendation: Keep dimmability only when direct competitor examples or the category use case make it important.

values.label: Selectable CCT
values.recommendation: Keep selectable CCT when direct competitor examples show it as a repeated buying filter.
